description: This PHP file defines an interface 'ValueYNormalizable' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. The interface declares a single method 'toArrayYValue', intended for normalizing the 'y' value of filter fields in report filters within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: toArrayYValue
methods.description: Defines a method that should return an array representation of the normalized 'y' value for filter fields, or null if not applicable.
